findings.evidence: Associative.lean:49 `namespace TauCeti.Associative`, containing `dividedPower_mul_left` (:97), `mul_dividedPower` (:124), `dividedPower_mul_self` (:132), `self_mul_dividedPower` (:137); the new lemmas are under `namespace TauCeti` (Commutation.lean:37).
findings.fix: Declare both inside `namespace TauCeti.Associative` (dropping the `Associative.` prefixes in the statements) and update the two call sites in `Kostant/Commutation.lean`.
findings.issue: `ringChoose_mul_dividedPower_eq` (and `dividedPower_mul_ringChoose_eq`, line 61) are declared in bare `TauCeti`, while the entire divided-power API they extend lives in `TauCeti.Associative` — hence the `Associative.dividedPower` qualifiers in their own statements. They will not surface under `open TauCeti.Associative` alongside the lemmas they belong with.

findings.evidence: Semiconj.lean:93–96; companion `mul_pow_eq_pow_mul_add_nsmul` (:75) is the one that moves `a` right.
findings.fix: Change to "Moving `a` to the left across `x ^ n` …", matching `pow_mul_smeval_eq` (:121) and `pow_mul_ringChoose_eq` (:166).
findings.issue: Docstring of `pow_mul_eq_sub_nsmul_mul_pow` says "Moving `a` to the right across `x ^ n`", but the statement `x ^ n * a = (a - n • c) * x ^ n` moves `a` from the right to the left. Direction is inverted relative to every sibling lemma.

findings.evidence: RingTheory/DividedPowers/Commutation.lean:47 `noncomputable local instance moduleNNRat : Module ℚ≥0 A`; Kostant/Form.lean:70 `noncomputable local instance moduleNNRat`; both imported at Kostant/Commutation.lean:8–9.
findings.fix: Delete the declaration and write `attribute [local instance] TauCeti.moduleNNRat` before opening the namespace; that instance (`{A} [Ring A] [Algebra ℚ A]`) already applies to `U`.
findings.issue: `moduleNNRatCommutation` disambiguates by module file name, not by anything about the object; it is a third copy of the same `Module.compHom` instance, needed only because `TauCeti.moduleNNRat` and `TauCeti.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.moduleNNRat` are both in scope here.

findings.evidence: Associative.lean uses `mul_dividedPower` (:124), `dividedPower_mul_self` (:132), `self_mul_dividedPower` (:137) with no suffix, and `factorial_smul_dividedPower_eq_pow` (:81) with the informative `_eq_pow`.
findings.fix: Drop the trailing `_eq` from all six: `ringChoose_mul_pow`, `pow_mul_ringChoose`, `smeval_mul_pow`, `pow_mul_smeval`, `ringChoose_mul_dividedPower`, `dividedPower_mul_ringChoose`.
findings.issue: Trailing bare `_eq` conveys nothing (the name already ends at the LHS description) and contradicts the sibling API, which uses `_eq_` only between an LHS and an RHS description. Affects `ringChoose_mul_pow_eq` (:138), `pow_mul_ringChoose_eq` (:168), `smeval_mul_pow_eq` (:112), `pow_mul_smeval_eq` (:123), and `ringChoose_mul_dividedPower_eq` / `dividedPower_mul_ringChoose_eq` (DividedPowers/Commutation.lean:52,61) — while the PR's own specializations `ringChoose_ι_mul_dividedPower_ι` / `dividedPower_ι_mul_ringChoose_ι` correctly omit it.

summary: The new divided-power lemmas are placed in the bare `TauCeti` namespace instead of `TauCeti.Associative` where the rest of the divided-power API lives, one docstring states the wrong direction, an instance is disambiguated by file name, and the `_eq` suffix contradicts the sibling convention.
